asc_farmer.text: We grow bananas, tomatoes, lettuces, tomatoes and more tomatoes. I'll tell you now that a banana from this farm has travelled seven miles.
In the old days, the Marines carried water down the mountain in barrels on a donkey cart. The donkeys have retired. The barrels have not.

asc_botanist.text: Hooker's forest is a strange thing. Almost every plant here has been brought from elsewhere, and yet it is a real forest, and the island's only cloud forest. Is that a fake? I've spent my career not answering that.
The tree fern is the only native plant I can promise you. It's on the rocks above. You'll want a fair bit of breath.

asc_walker.text: The climb to the top of the mountain takes about two hours on a path made of cinder and thought. At the top you walk into cloud, and the cloud is cold, and you remember you are standing in the Tropics.
I've taken the same path forty times and there is always a different bird.
